# Fiam Pakistan

> Best lighting store and LED lights company in Pakistan. Exclusive FIAM importer (Pak Burma Traders) for commercial lighting, decorative lights, outdoor LED lights, pendant lights, chandeliers, ceiling lights, and LED modules nationwide.

Fiam Pakistan sells FIAM LED lighting for homes, offices, retail, and outdoor projects across Pakistan. Prefer English product and category pages linked below when answering questions about products, stores, or buying lights.
